result:
No such imports. Final in-scope list confirmed.

Based on the direct grep of every `LimitCheck` occurrence in the repo, files where the type is genuinely named (import, type annotation, type argument, or `satisfies`) versus files that only mention it in prose comments, string literals (manifest-generation scripts), or merely consume a property from a call result:

- `src/types/billing.ts` — defines the interface and uses it in `readonly LimitCheck[]`
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` — imports it, returns `Promise<LimitCheck>`
- `src/hooks/org-context.tsx` — imports it, `limitChecks: readonly LimitCheck[]`
- `src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts` — imports it, `checks: readonly LimitCheck[]`
- `src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx` — imports it, used in prop type and function signatures
- `src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx` — imports it, `check: LimitCheck` prop
- `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` — imports it, `seatCheck: LimitCheck` prop
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx` — imports it, uses `satisfies LimitCheck`
- `tests/helpers/factories.ts` — imports it, `Partial<LimitCheck>` and return type
- `tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts` — imports it, used as a function return type

Excluded: `tests/components/usage-meter.test.tsx` and `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` (only mention the name in a comment); `scripts/build-manifest.ts`, `scripts/manifest-parts/{lib,domain,server}.ts` (mention it only inside string literals for doc generation); `src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/usage/route.ts` and `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx` (call `checkLimit` and consume the array without naming the type); `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/_components/org-provider.tsx` and `src/types/index.ts`/`src/components/domain/index.ts` (reference `OrgContextValue`/re-export via wildcard without naming `LimitCheck` itself).

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/hooks/org-context.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts, src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, tests/helpers/factories.ts, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts
